sentences.text: For the Petitioner : Mr. Anurag Kashyap, Advocate For the State : Mr. Manoj Kr. Mishra, A.P.P For the Opp.
Party No.2 : Mr. Manoj Kumar No.2, Advocate --------

The petitioner is apprehending his arrest in connection with Bhavnathpur P.S. Case No. 107 of 2022, for the offences under Sections 498A, 323, 379, 385, 387, 511, 504 of the Indian Penal Code and Sections 3 / 4 of Dowry Prohibition Act, pending in the court of learned S.D.J.M., Nagar Untari,
Garhwa.
Petitioner is the husband of the informant.
Vide order dated 09.12.2022, the matter was referred to JHALSA for initiating mediation process for resolution of dispute between the parties.
The report of the Member Secretary of JHALSA is available on record.
It appears that the parties have resolved their dispute.
The matter relates to matrimonial dispute between the parties.
Considering the aforesaid fact; I am inclined to extend the privilege of anticipatory bail to the petitioner.

He is directed to surrender before the court below within two weeks from the date of Anil Ram @ Anil Kumar Ram vs The State Of Jharkhand & Anr. ..... .... ... on 21 March, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/83605841/
1 receipt of a copy of this order and the learned court below on his surrender shall release him on bail on furnishing bail bond of Rs.25,000/-(Rupees Twenty Five Thousand) with two sureties of the like amount each, to the satisfaction of learned S.D.J.M., Nagar Untari, Garhwa, in connection with Bhavnathpur P.S. Case No. 107 of 2022, subject to the the conditions as laid down under Section 438 (2) Cr.P.C.
BS/ (Ambuj Nath, J.)
